title: Mako Tools 2.8.0 Turbo & Mako Quick Tools Studio
changelog: Added standalone Mako Quick Tools dockable extension panel for native AE docking and tear-off
Unified Quick Tools bar combining editing tools and quick presets into a streamlined strip
Quick Tools Studio (⚙️) modal for reordering, toggling visibility, and deleting buttons
Add Custom Preset feature with 48-icon visual picker and instant catalog preset selection
1-click Detach button (↗) inside main Mako Tools to spawn Quick Tools panel instantly in AE
Icons & Vectors: Fast vector icons catalog (Iconify) with dual insertion formats: Editable Shape Layer and HD PNG
Dynamic Captions: Centered section header with live item count and real-time search filtering
Full support for Native AE Effects (Gaussian Blur, Curves, Glow, Transform, etc.) and 100% responsive fluid layout
Curvas Bézier cinematográficas e controle ultra suave
Suporte a auto-atualização direta no painel e via ZXP
